judge.rationale: The candidate only generated a `.lore/dod.md` planning file, updated `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md`, and added an acceptance test in a new file `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.acceptance.test.ts`. It never actually modified `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts` to fix the `error instanceof Error` gate, nor did it update `CHANGELOG.md`. Because the production code is untouched, the newly added test will fail and `npm test` will break. While the spec edit and test logic closely match the ticket and reference, failing to implement the actual fix and changelog update leaves the task largely incomplete and broken.
